title: Privacy Policy
metaDescription: Learn how Creative Atlas collects, uses, stores, and protects personal information.
introductionText: This Privacy Policy explains how personal information is collected, used, stored, and protected when you visit or use Creative Atlas (https://creativeatlas.co). It applies to website visitors, artists, and users with administrative access to the platform.
controllerText:

dataCollectedText:
Artist profiles: names, biographies, profile photographs, country, and other information provided for public display. Depending on the information supplied, artist biographies and other profile content may contain personal information.

Account information: email addresses, account roles, authentication credentials stored as password hashes, account status, invitation records, and session information.

Visitor inquiries: name, email address, message, associated artist or artwork, inquiry status, and relevant timestamps.

Technical information: information necessary for operating, securing, and troubleshooting the platform, which may include IP addresses, request metadata, and technical logs maintained by our hosting and infrastructure providers.

Creative Atlas does not currently process payments or store payment card information.
purposesText:
We process personal information to publish artist profiles and artworks, provide account access, manage invitations, facilitate inquiries between visitors and artists, send necessary service notifications, maintain platform security, prevent misuse, provide support, and comply with applicable legal obligations.

Published artist information is visible to visitors. Inquiry information is accessible to authorized administrators and relevant artist accounts according to their permissions.
legalBasisText:
Depending on the processing activity and applicable law, we rely on the performance of an agreement or steps requested before entering into an agreement, legitimate interests in operating and protecting the platform and facilitating communications, compliance with legal obligations, or consent where legally required.

The applicable legal basis depends on the purpose and circumstances of processing. Where consent is required, it may be withdrawn subject to applicable law.
sharingText:
Creative Atlas uses external service providers to operate the platform:

Vercel — frontend hosting and delivery.
Render — backend hosting and database infrastructure.
Cloudinary — storage, transformation, and delivery of artist and artwork images.
Resend — delivery of transactional emails and inquiry notifications.

These providers may process information as necessary to deliver their services. We do not sell personal information to advertisers. Personal information may also be disclosed where required by law or necessary to protect lawful rights and platform security.
transfersText:
Some of the service providers used by Creative Atlas operate internationally. As a result, personal information may be processed, stored, or accessed outside the Republic of Serbia, including in the European Union and the United States.

We use Vercel for frontend hosting, Render for backend and database infrastructure, Cloudinary for image management, and Resend for transactional email delivery.

Where required by applicable data protection law, international transfers are subject to appropriate legal safeguards. We are reviewing the relevant contractual arrangements, processing locations, and transfer mechanisms for each provider.

For questions about international transfers of personal information, contact hello@creativeatlas.co.
cookiesText:
Creative Atlas currently uses an authentication cookie named admin_session to maintain administrator login sessions and an i18next cookie to remember language preferences. The authentication cookie is used for account access and security, while the language cookie supports the selected website language.

The reviewed application does not currently include Google Analytics, Meta Pixel, or PostHog tracking. Cookies and other technologies will be reviewed if new functionality or analytics services are introduced. Any legally required consent mechanism will be implemented before the relevant technology is activated.
retentionText:
We retain personal information only for as long as necessary for the purposes described in this Policy or as required by law.

Visitor inquiries: retained for up to 365 days from the last modification of the inquiry, unless an earlier valid deletion request applies or a lawful reason requires longer retention. Changes to an inquiry's status update the last modification timestamp and restart the 365-day retention period.

Expired or revoked sessions: deleted 30 days after expiration or revocation.

Expired, unaccepted invitations: deleted 30 days after expiration.

Accepted invitations: deleted 30 days after acceptance.

Account and published profile information: retained while the relevant account or content remains active, subject to deletion requests and applicable legal obligations.

Retention periods are enforced through scheduled automated cleanup processes.
securityText:
We use reasonable technical and organizational measures to protect personal information. These include access controls, role-based permissions, password hashing, session-based authentication, and appropriate security settings for production services.

No internet-based service can guarantee absolute security. We review and improve safeguards as the platform develops.
rightsText:
Subject to applicable law, individuals may request access to their personal information, correction of inaccurate information, deletion, restriction of processing, objection to certain processing activities, and other rights provided by law. Where processing is based on consent, individuals may request withdrawal of that consent.

To exercise your rights, contact hello@creativeatlas.co. We may request information reasonably necessary to verify your identity before responding. Requests will be handled within applicable legal time limits. Individuals may also have the right to submit a complaint to the competent data protection authority.
changesText: We may update this Privacy Policy to reflect changes in our services, data processing practices, or applicable legal requirements. The updated version and its effective date will be published on this page. Where required, we will provide additional notice.
contactText: For privacy questions, requests to access or delete personal information, or concerns about data processing, contact D3W TAG / Creative Atlas at hello@creativeatlas.co.
